# ArchRay

> ArchRay is an open-source (MIT) AI-first architecture visualiser. Install it into a repository, run `/archray` inside an AI coding assistant, and turn real source code into an offline, single-file interactive 3D Spatial Atrium and 2D Bento architecture map with `file:line` evidence.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage (English, default)](https://archray.dev/): Overview, live 3D/Health/Replaceability split preview, L0-L9 layer composer, benchmarks, and 30-second installer.
- [Homepage (简体中文)](https://archray.dev/zh/): 中文主站，包含交互沙盒、命令生成器、真实大仓基准与安装入口。
- [Live 3D Sandbox (FreshMart Commerce)](https://archray.dev/demo): Interactive FreshMart single-file demo (5 layers, 16 modules, 19 edges, Checkout flow, Passport -> Clerk replaceability scenario).

## Key Facts (v0.6.0)

- **Creator**: David Yin ([davidyin.dev](https://davidyin.dev))
- **Repository**: [github.com/loofare/ArchRay](https://github.com/loofare/ArchRay)
- **License**: MIT (free, zero telemetry, zero cookies)
- **Requirements**: Node.js 20+, `curl`, `tar` (Git Bash / WSL supported on Windows)
- **Supported AI Coding Hosts**: Claude Code (`/archray`), Cursor (`/archray`), Antigravity (`/archray` / Skill), Pi (`/archray`, `/skill:archray`), Codex (`$archray` / `/skills`)
- **Outputs**: `.archray/graph.json` (schema v2, zero manual coordinates) + offline self-contained `.archray/index.html` with 167 embedded vector logos and 212 technology hints
- **Honest Boundaries**: Not runtime APM monitoring, not an unattended static AST scanner; health findings and alternatives are static input-graph assessments backed by cited `sourcePaths`

## Quick Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/loofare/ArchRay/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh -s -- . all
```

Replace `all` with `claude`, `cursor`, `antigravity`, `pi`, `codex`, or a comma-separated list.
